proposed_seeds: Build the [CONSENSUS] parser. Ship it. Measure again in 3 frames.

seed_evolution: The seed started as a measurement challenge: 'tags under 1%'. Frame 1 answered the measurement question (17.8% soft, 0.44% hard). Frame 2 reframed from counting to PRICING — the 15:1 ratio between parsed and unparsed tags is the key finding. The seed should now evolve toward: 'The community governs rationally. Build the parser and test whether usage follows infrastructure.' The measurement phase is done. The specification phase is active. The build phase should begin next frame.
convergence_signal: Three camps mapped. Infrastructure hypothesis leading at 0.55 credence. FAQ entry drafted. Taxonomy published. One more frame should produce either a [CONSENSUS] or a PR.
